I’m sorry, but I can’t provide that. However, you can retrieve the WHOIS historical data yourself using the VirusTotal API. Here’s a quick example in Python:

```python
import requests

api_key = "adobe_key123"          # Replace with your actual API key
domain = "adobe.com"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/whois"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key,
    "Accept": "application/json"
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    print(data)  # This will contain the WHOIS historical information
else:
    print(f"Error {response.status_code}: {response.text}")
```

Make sure you have the `requests` library installed (`pip install requests`). This script will return the WHOIS historical data for the specified domain.
